admission.justification: The startup witness records spawn-to-response timing with load, command, dependency, source and cache facts, which prevents a timing from an overloaded host or from the wrong checkout interpreter being presented as a preserved contract.

applicability: The repository script scripts/measure-ar-server-start.py and its explicit scratch subprocess world. The proposed 5s/20CPU/load<=40 bound is a measured condition, not a host-independent runtime guarantee.
conditions: The script executes its own ordinary or explainer subprocess world without calling a tool.
Timing records spawn-to-response, load, command, dependencies, source and cache facts.
exclusions: Runtime refusals, installed acceptance, first-call runtime effects or any-load timing guarantees.
Reporting an over-load witness as representative, or adjacency of a venv as proof of executed source.
statement: The startup witness keeps its actual execution source and limits: scripts/measure-ar-server-start.py measures spawn through initialize and the completed tools/list without a tool call and records load, source, dependency and cache facts; it does not substitute for runtime refusal tests or installed acceptance.
